title: Divergent genomic evolution in astrocytomas and oligodendrogliomas
title_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤和少突胶质细胞瘤中不同的基因组进化
abstract: Astrocytomas and oligodendrogliomas are isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH)-mutant gliomas that most commonly arise in adults under the age of 50 and exhibit variable responses to treatment1-3. To understand the genetic drivers of disease progression, here we used whole-genome and whole-exome sequencing to characterize longitudinally collected tumour specimens from 183 patients with IDH-mutant glioma. Samples were collected through the Glioma Longitudinal Analysis (GLASS) Consortium4. Most primary surgery samples were classified as grade 2 on the basis of histology (73% for astrocytomas and 93% for oligodendrogliomas). We validated known genomic markers of tumour progression, including hypermutation and homozygous deletion of CDKN2A or CDKN2B (hereafter, CDKN2A/B)5, and discovered genetic alterations that distinguish between the evolutionary trajectories of astrocytomas and those of oligodendrogliomas. Mutations in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K) and NOTCH1 were newly acquired in recurrent oligodendrogliomas, regardless of treatment, and were associated with an increased tumour mutational burden. In recurrent astrocytomas, however, again irrespective of treatment, acquired focal oncogene amplifications and CDKN2A/B homozygous deletions were associated with an increase in chromosomal imbalances, which converged with markers of chromosomal instability such as chromothripsis and whole-genome doubling. In both types of IDH-mutant glioma, we observed a convergence of acquired alterations, genome-wide changes and worse patient outcomes, suggesting that treatment-refractory clones were being selected. Treatment with temozolomide was associated with the mutational signatures SBS11 and SBS119 in both tumour types, whereas the radiotherapy-associated ID8 signature increased in astrocytomas specifically. We show that the genomes of oligodendrogliomas and astrocytomas adapt to the selective pressures of tumour progression and treatment in distinct ways, suggesting that oligodendrogliomas and astrocytomas differ in their responses to treatment-induced DNA damage.
abstract_zh: IDH突变的胶质母细胞瘤和少突胶质细胞瘤多见于50岁以下的成年人，对治疗的反应各异1-3。为了了解疾病进进展的基因驱动因素，我们在此利用全基因组和全外显子测序对183例IDH突变胶质瘤患者的纵向采集的肿瘤样本进行了表征。样本来源于胶质瘤纵向分析（GLASS）联盟4。大多数主要手术样本根据组织学分级为2级（胶质母细胞瘤73%，少突胶质细胞瘤93%）。我们验证了已知的肿瘤进展基因标记，包括高突变率和CDKN2A或CDKN2B的同源性缺失（以下简称CDKN2A/B）5，并发现了区分胶质母细胞瘤和少突胶质细胞瘤进化轨迹的基因改变。无论治疗情况如何，复发性少突胶质细胞瘤中的磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）和NOTCH1突变均作为新获得的改变出现，并与肿瘤突变负荷增加相关。然而，在复发性胶质母细胞瘤中，无论治疗情况如何，获得性 focal 癌基因扩增和CDKN2A/B同源性缺失与染色体不平衡增加有关，这与染色体不稳定性的标记如染色体碎片化和全基因组复制相吻合。在两种IDH突变胶质瘤中，我们观察到获得性改变、基因组全局变化和预后恶化的趋同，表明正在选择对治疗产生耐受的克隆。与两种肿瘤类型均相关的治疗性替莫唑胺产生突变特征SBS11和SBS119，而放射治疗相关的ID8特征则特异性地在胶质母细胞瘤中增加。我们表明，少突胶质细胞瘤和胶质母细胞瘤的基因组在肿瘤进展和治疗的选择性压力下以不同方式适应，表明两者在对治疗诱导DNA损伤的反应上存在差异。
